experiments.title: Curuai exposed water with NISAR L-band
experiments.scope: The original QGIS HH threshold and a two-feature logistic model were fitted on 246,621 cells in August 2026. Both were evaluated against same-day Sentinel-2A optical labels at Lago Grande de Curuai, Brazil, on buffered August spatial holdout blocks and again in October with both models unchanged.

metrics.label: August water IoU · HH and HH–HV logistic
October water IoU · frozen HH threshold
Paired exposed-water loss recall · HH threshold

notes: Intersection over union (IoU) is measured against the optical labels. Both models used the same support within each comparison: 247,769 August cells, 181,423 October cells, and 146,534 paired cells, all at 60 m.

The HH threshold recovered 4,359 of 31,808 optically labelled loss cells. The logistic model recovered 2,949. The comparison covers exposed water in one wetland and two observation dates. Sentinel-2A observed the site about 4 hours 52 minutes after each radar pass.
